slices.behaviour: A Jev reply that leaves one answer key out records that one absence and keeps the rest, a stage gate still refuses one, the review gate refuses an advance whose diff has moved since the triage while forgiving the ticket file and the generated copies, and delivery passes the reviewer tokens into kpi.json
slices.failure_reason: HarnessError: The API answered without criterion_evidenced#2, raised out of the triage so no record was written; AssertionError: HarnessError not raised, for a file added after the triage; KeyError: 'code_fingerprint'; and 'reviewer_tokens' not found in the source of delivery.verify
